content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] controller and am unable to activate the web server. I can access the device through the network using the [product_name] configuration software—the test and connect functions work—but I can't change parameters while online. Browsing to the generic web server works and displays the device representation, but I can't access my customized page. Uploading and downloading the program is possible. What steps should I take?
Hi [user_name], You may find a useful step-by-step guide for proper configuration by following this link: [document] [url]

Starting from [product_name] version [version_no], there are two integrated web servers: a simple web server that shows the display or operator panel, and an extended web server for user-designed websites. These pages are created using the free [product_name] web editor. If you’re not able to access the extended web server, please provide further details to assist you. Which exact [product_name] module do you have? Please share its article number, and confirm if a FAT32-formatted SD card is installed.

I have a [product_name]: [product_name] [article_no] Firmware version: [version_no]. There's a FAT32 SD card inside. I can access it via browser and log in with the default password to view the menu and the device image. Variables, basic modules, and the operator panel are accessible. However, accessing my custom site results in a 404 error. Using [product_name] configuration software, I get a 'Function not available' error when changing online parameters. The device is on a local network without internet access. Thank you for your help.
Have you uploaded your [product_name] Web Editor project to the SD card of the [product_name]?
When I remove the SD card from the [product_name], I receive this message: [IMAGE]

When attempting to upload a web project via the editor, the upload fails with the message: 'SD card in system not found.' I used the SD card icon in the editor to deploy the project, but nothing else happens. Thank you.
It seems you have a problem with the SD card.
Insert the SD card into the [product_name] and try this: [IMAGE]
I receive the same message: 'Download failed! SD card file system is not found.' I checked my SD card—it's 8GB, FAT32 formatted, and empty.
Your issue appears to be with the SD card; the device isn’t recognizing it. Some users have found that the card slot pins may be bent.

This is exactly my problem. I tried another [product_name] module and transfer works. However, I still can’t activate the web server using the configuration software—always the same error message in French ('Echec au chargement du panneau'), similar to 'Failed to access the panel' in English.
What type of [product_name] is the other module? Is it also [product_name] [article_no] with firmware [version_no]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing persistent difficulties enabling and configuring web server features on their [product_name] device. Standard network functions, including basic web interface access, work as intended. However, custom web pages (on the extended web server) fail to load due to SD card recognition problems, leading to error messages when trying to detect or use the SD card for uploads or downloads. These ongoing challenges are causing users notable frustration and preventing access to personalized web capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy process for activating, configuring, and accessing custom web pages via the extended web server on their [product_name] devices, along with smooth project deployment through SD card usage.
